scope: From the seat of the visa applicant and visa holder (Priya, on the partner pathway; the engineer Jarrah sponsors on a Skills in Demand visa), for the WA life of Daniel (d033, d035, d047). Act: ss 13, 14, 42 (who needs a visa), 29, 30, 5F, 5CB, 65, 72, 73, 79, 81(2), 82(2), (3), (5), (6), (8), 116(1), (1AA)-(1AC), (2), 117(2), 119, 128, s 5(1) approved work sponsor, 140E, 140GB(2), 140H, 140Q, 486R(5), 245AS, 245AB, 245AC, 245AG (s 235 is repealed). Regulations: the temporary and permanent partner visas (Sch 1 item 1214C; Sch 2 Parts 820, 801; reg 1.03 long-term partner relationship and Australian permanent resident), the Bridging A visa in between (Part 010, with condition 8105 carried over), the five-year travel facility of the 801 and the resident return visa (cl 801.511; item 1128; Part 155), the Skills in Demand visa in the Specialist Skills and Core Skills streams (item 1240; Part 482; regs 2.72(8), (15), 2.75; the income thresholds of reg 1.03 with reg 5.42A, $135,000 and $73,150 as floors), its conditions 8607 and 8501, and the sponsorship obligations that protect the worker (regs 2.79, 2.80, 2.87). Out: every other subclass, the Labour Agreement stream, the public interest and special return criteria (asked as facts), application charges for the partner visas, the instruments setting occupation lists, market salary method, exemption amounts and the current indexed thresholds (inputs), labour market testing and the sponsor's own approval criteria, other sponsorship obligations and sanctions, character cancellation and all other cancellation powers, review, detention and removal.
seat: the visa applicant and visa holder (Priya on the partner visa pathway; the sponsored skilled worker on a Skills in Demand visa)
